name: Ferrum
summary: A city of machines losing power district by district.
description: A world from ARCHIVE: Worlds Within Worlds (chapter 4). It is drawn by the film's raymarching shader (worlds-within-worlds/src/worlds/40_ferrum.glsl). Opens the film studio at this chapter; a standalone interactive version is a planned adaptation (see docs/RECOMMENDATIONS.md).

status.notes: Viewable in the film studio; interactive adaptation planned.
